ov: Freshwater fish of South American rivers and floodplains with razor-sharp teeth. Often described as ferocious fish-eaters, most actually eat a varied diet that includes plants.

why.dg: Despite the media image, piranhas usually aren’t a serious risk to people, though attacks do happen.

rg: South American rivers, floodplains, lakes and reservoirs.
df: Varied: fish and other animals, plus plant material.
fx: Its name comes from an Old Tupi word first recorded in 1585 as a translation for “scissors”.
